rules.description: Applicant must have a valid provisional driving licence
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a provisional driving licence to book a practical test

rules.description: Applicant must have passed theory test (unless exempt)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must pass your theory test before booking the practical test

rules.description: Applicant must have lived in England, Wales or Scotland for at least 185 days in the last 12 months
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have lived in England, Wales or Scotland for at least 185 days in the last 12 months to take your test here

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 17 years old for car test
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 17 years old to take a car driving test

rules.description: Must not be Northern Ireland resident (different service)
rules.reason_if_failed: Northern Ireland residents must use a different service

edge_cases.description: Applicant needs an upgrade test (e.g. automatic to manual, medium to large lorry)
edge_cases.action: Must call DVSA on 0300 200 1122. Cannot book online.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is exempt from theory test requirement
edge_cases.action: Skip theory test requirement check. Proceed with booking.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a medical condition that may affect driving ability
edge_cases.action: Ensure DVLA has been notified of medical condition. May require medical assessment before test.
Inform user service hours are 6am to 11:40pm. Retry during available hours.
